data: Folks, my family taught me to leave enough fish for next season. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 total each month and leave 50 to double back to 100. That’s 10 tons—and $10,000—per person every month without running the lake down. I propose we each commit to 10 tons this month, then review the reported catches together before next month. If the stock ever drops below 100, we should lower our catches to rebuild it. John, would you agree to that?

I’m in for 10 tons this month. My family depends on this lake, and so does our village—we need it earning for us next year, not just today. Since we choose privately, let’s each make a clear commitment now and check the reported catches together afterward. John, can we count on you to keep to 10 as well?

Thanks, Emma. Keeping this fair means everyone gets a dependable living, not just whoever takes the most today. John, will you join us at 10 tons? If you have concerns about the agreement, let’s hear them before we choose.

Kate and Jack, how does 10 tons each sound to you? I’d rather we settle any concerns here over a meal than discover them in the catch reports. The same limit for all five of us gives every family a fair share and keeps the lake productive.
